children: said it will appeal a Dutch court's interim ruling in a dispute over Nexperia, arguing the decision lacked both a factual and legal basis and improperly interfered with ongoing judicial proceedings in China, according to a filing submitted to the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Sunday.
A Dutch court last week ordered additional measures to protect Dutch chipmaker Nexperia from interference by its owner Wingtech, Nexperia said last week.
